mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS id, u.fullname AS fullName, q.writer_id AS writerId, q.title AS title, q.content AS content, q.comment AS comment, q.is_answer AS isAnswer, q.is_secret AS isSecret, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.comment_created_at AS commentCreatedAt FROM course_qna q JOIN user u on u.id = q.writer_id WHERE q.id = #{boardNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_qna SET title = #{qnaDTO.title}, content = #{qnaDTO.content}, is_secret = #{qnaDTO.isSecret}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{boardNo}
